name: contract-check
what: A contract line is reported PROVEN only when its test passes clean and fails once its planted fault is in place, and the exit code is 0 only when every line is PROVEN.

faults.fault: A line whose test still passes with the fault in place is reported as PROVEN.
A line that was proven is reported as UNPROVEN.
The exit code ignores MISSED lines and fails only on UNPROVEN ones.
The --changed filter is ignored, so every contract is proved again.
